balls.text: short of length delivery outside off, slightly slower as well, the batsman can only hit it as far as midwicket, that keeps them to a single
length delivery outside off, the batsman pushes it straight to Sanga at cover and they take off for a single
he bowls it short at the new man, the batsman tries to hook it but gets hit on the gloves, takes the single anyway
a low full-toss outside off, the batsman wanted to crack it over extra cover, but gets a toe-end to that lobs it tamely to Sanga at extra cover
full delivery outside off, it's driven in the air to wide long-on

slower delivery outside off, it's fuller in length and the batsman goes for a golf-swing, he had everything in his favour, but not the pace.. He ends up smacking it high towards midwicket where Cameron White runs backwards and completes the catch
another edge, this one goes over the keeper's head, more agony for Steyn...
full delivery on the pads, the batsman charges down the wicket and is only able to push it to midwicket
he bowls it short, slightly slower, the batsman flat-bats it to deep midwicket where the fielder makes a good sliding save

bowls a slower delivery and it completely foxes the batsman who was going over extra cover, he gets a big leading edge that goes really really high, the fielder from third-man tries to get under it and drops it ... Another easy catch goes down
he goes deep into the crease and pushes the length delivery in the gap at off
full yorker outside off, the batsman makes room and blocks it towards point for a single

the extra delivery earns him a wicket! Another catch at mid-off as the batsman tries to drive it over mid-off, he doesn't get the elevation and hits it flat, the fielder moves a step to his right and takes a good smart catch
quick length delivery down the leg side, the batsman takes a swing nonetheless, but misses. It is down the leg side
length delivery on the pads, slower again, it is helped to the fielder at short fine leg
this time it is a slower delivery, the batsman waits and drags it over midwicket in the gap
bowls a beamer at full pace, the batsman misses, and the umpire misses it too.. That was clearly over waist high!!
beautiful slower delivery on a length, the batsman gets completely beaten in his cut shot, it just misses the off stump too
bowls a low full toss wide outside off, the batsman tries to guide it fine on the off side, but misses

easy one as this one is caught at mid-off! Too eager to go after Steyn or what? It was an offcutter on a length outside off, the batsman tries to smash it over mid-off, but gets his timing all messed up, ends up giving up a gentle lob to the fielder there..
shorter delivery outside off, the batsman gets under it and ramps it over backward point, with no timing, it falls between point and third man
length delivery outside off, slightly slower, the batsman tries to slog it to the leg side but gets an inside edge  to fine leg
but he comes down the pitch and makes room as he does so, clobbers the length ball through cover with some brute force
length delivery outside off, the batsman plays one of those little dabs he has been playing all through, sends it through where first slip would have been
length delivery a touch wide outside off, the batsman goes forward to push it to off, but gets an inside edge past the non-striker
slower and a normal legspinner outside off,the batsman punches it off the back foot, but straight to cover again
he goes on the back foot and punches it straight to cover
Ishant has dropped this one at deep midwicket! Horrible.. The batsman went for a slog of a flighted delivery and it just lobbed towards the fielder, easy catch put down
bowls the wrong'un this time, the batsman gets beaten as he comes forward to defend, plays outside the line
tossed up on the middle stump, the batsman goes back and dabs it towards the right of non-striker to take a quick single
comes down the pitch and Mishra bowls it short and quick, the batsman ends up pushing it back to the bowler
length delivery on off, defended towards cover off the front foot
he waits on the back foot and opens the face to run it down to third man
length delivery, the batsman clears his front foot and murders it, absolutely he does, but this one goes really high and drops just short of the boundary at long-on, then trickles over the rope
another length delivery just outside off, steered to third man for a single
fuller length delivery wide outside off, it is a touch slower too, the batsman drives it through extra cover
back of length delivery on off stump, Moises guides it to gully for a single

he has taken it! Reddy has struck a big blow! He bowls another slower ball and Kohli goes forward to drives it to the leg side, but the length is shorter than Kohli thought it was, it bounces, catches the shoulder of the bat and pops up back towards the bowler, who dives forward to scoop up a good catch..
slower delivery on off, messes with Kohli's timing as he ends up tamely pushing it back to the bowler
length delivery but very wide outside off, Kohli slaps it with a horizontal bat, crashes it to the boundary at deep point
slower delivery bowled off the back of the hands, the batsman waits and pushes it to deep cover
back of length this time, just outside off, Kohli punches it to deep cover
starts off with a short and wide delivery, the batsman waits in the crease and punches it hard to deep cover
length ball outside off, the batsman bends his knees a bit and upper cuts it, it goes to Steyn at third man on the bounce
back of length delivery on off, it is chopped towards gully and they take a quick single
length ball outside off, he slices it past point for a  quick couple
that's some show of authority! He comes down the pitch and whacks the length ball straight down the ground, 95 meters over long-off and into the second tier
beautiful work by the fielder at point, but he is not able to prevent the single.
back of length delivery on off stump, the batsman gets on top of the bounce and punches it to deep cover
he comes down the pitch and jabs the full delivery towards midwicket where the fielder makes a good diving stop and throws the ball at non-striker's end, but they just complete the single in time
stays in the crease and dabs it towards cover for a quick single
tries to late cut a ball on the middle stump line, but chops it to gully as there is no room
pushed through on the stumps, the batsman defends it back to the bowler
shorter and flatter, follows the batsman as he makes room, Kohli tries to pull it but doesn't time it well, it goes past a diving midwicket fielder
pushed through on the pads, the batsman goes back and whips it to deep square leg
flatter and shorter outside off, Kohli punches it hard but straight to cover
he comes forward and dabs it to cover, takes off for a quick single
tossed up delivery on off, pushed to cover off the front foot
length delivery outside off, punched down the ground to long-off
flatter and shorter on the middle and leg, just the invitation for Kohli to smack it over midwicket off the back foot
bowls a flatter delivery on off stump, the batsman goes back and punches it to deep point
bowls a top spinner on off stump, the batsman comes forward and defends it back to the bowler
tossed up delivery outside off, Moises goes after it and plays a risky slices over the infield
bowls a flatter delivery on the legs, it hits the pads, but is going down leg
this one has been pierced pass gully with a super late cut, the ball itself was a beautiful teasing delivery outside off
bowls a tossed up delivery on off stump, driven down to long-off
length delivery, slower, outside off, the batsman comes forward and defends
comes down the pitch and punches the length delivery to deep point
this time he waits in the crease and punches the length ball to deep extra cover
length delivery on off, the batsman comes forward and drives it to Sanga at cover
slower ball outside off, he waits for it and then opens the face to run it down to third man
length delivery outside off, the batsman pushes it to point
again gets beaten by the length of that, goes back to defends and is a bit late to bring the bat down
was that the googly! Probably was, Kohli gets hit on the pads as he comes forward to defends, was going down leg side
quicker delivery, Kohli goes back and defends it back to the bowler
full and flighted on the middle and leg stump, the batsman takes his front foot out and drives it to long-off
bowls a slower tossed up delivery on the stumps, the batsman has to wait for it, he defends it to off

strikes first ball! the second-highest wicket taker in IPL, bowls it flatter on the middle stump, the batsman comes forward but plays down the wrong line, he is hit in front of the middle as the ball straightens, the umpire doesn't take long to raise his finger.. Sunrisers are on a roll here..
bowls length, keeps it slightly slower too, the batsman comes forward and pushes it to point
length delivery, slightly slower and on off stump, the batsman defends it off the back foot
goes on the back foot and punches it to the gap at cover for a quick single
he charges down the ground and makes room along the way, but Perera bowls it slow and the batsman is through with the shot, the ball arrives later..beaten
another back of length delivery outside off, the batsman goes on the back foot and punches it to point
bowls length outside off, the batsman steers it down to third man for a single
length delivery outside off, the batsman comes forward and slices it past point for a couple
oh that bounces extra!! It was short of length outside off, the batsman goes for a cut, but it takes off and beats the bat, Parthiv takes it above his head
back of length delivery outside off, the batsman guides it down to third man
has that gone all the way! Ishant bowls it short and it doesn't have too much pace on it, Kohli goes for a pull and slaps it from right in front of his face.. It just drops short of the boundary
another tight delivery outside off, straightens a touch, Kohli defends it to the off side
length delivery outside off, the batsman defends it towards cover point
another flatter delivery, this time outside off, the batsman goes back and punches it to cover
shortens the length and bowls it on the stumps, Kohli goes back and punches it to wide mid-on
he has had enough, he comes down the track and drives it inside out over extra cover to send this to the boundary
beautiful delivery, it was quicker and flatter, it turned and took the outside edge to gully
tossed up and slow on the middle stump, the batsman defends it back to the bowler
flights it up to the batsman and he drives it to long-off, hello, but a wild throw comes in from Perera, it goes over the keeper and to the boundary..
length ball outside off, the batsman comes forward and defends it solidly
back of length delivery on the stumps, bounces a touch extra, the batsman gets behind it nicely and works it to deep backward square for a single
he knocks him over! It is a length delivery aimed at offstump, cuts in just enough to beat the batsman's forward prod and hits the top of off, pretty sight for Ishant, not so much for Dilshan ..
length delivery on the stumps, Kohli dabs it towards mid-on with soft hands and calls for a quick one
length delivery on stumps, it gets good bounce and beats the bat as Dilshan comes forward, hits his thigh pad and rolls towards gully
he bowls back of length delivery on the stumps, Kohli gets up on his toes and whips it to deep backward square leg
another short delivery outside off, Kohli hops up and gets on top of the bounce, chops it down to third man
another short ball, this time it goes down the leg side and is called a wide, Steyn is not impressed as he thought it brushed something along the way..
he follows it up with a 143 kph bouncer, but it is a touch outside off, left alone with ease
short and wide, Kohli loves it, doesn't hit it too hard, just times it off the back foot past gully
back of length outside off, the batsman goes back and across and defends it to point
length delivery on off stump, Kohli comes solidly behind it and defends it mid-on
back of length delivery angling on the stumps, Kohli defends it to midwicket
this time he punches it straight down to long-on
pushed through on the stumps, Kohli defends it to midwicket
another flatter delivery on the stumps, the batsman goes on the back foot and punches it down the ground to long on
quicker and shorter on the pads, Dilshan goes back and works it to deep backward square leg for a couple
pushed through on the stumps, he comes forward and drives it to long on

has he got him! Hanuma Vihari is the man! He comes and bowls a gentle offspinner from round the wicket, it is a quickish delivery and bounces slightly extra, Gayle goes for a cut, but it was too close and he edges it to the keeper.. Gayle has been taken out, what a blow!  What are we going to do for the next 39 overs!!
length delivery on off stump, comes in with the angle, Dilshan comes forward to push it to off, but gets an inside edge on to his pads
poor delivery this one, it is fired down the leg side and it keeps going away from the keeper
length delivery fired on the pads, Dilshan misses his flick and gets hit on the pads, he thinks about a single but he is sent back by Gayle
fuller delivery on off stump, with slight swing, Dilshan drives it with a closed face of the bat, towards mid-on
back of length this time, 142 kph, Dilshan comes forward and defends it solidly to the off side
length delivery on off stump, the ball swings, the batsman comes forward and opens the face as he drives it, it is in the gap at cover point and they take a couple
fuller delivery outside off, shaping in to the left-hander, the batsman comes forward and drives it softly towards cover for a quick single
slower delivery, he misses it but runs a bye.. the keeper misses the stumps.. it's a tie.. it's a tie

bowls an excellent yorker on off stump, the batsman can only dig it out towards mid-off, and guess what, these two steal a couple.. there was a single in it.. at max.. Kohli lets Agarwal know what he thinks of that effort.. Vinay is livid too..
low full toss on the stumps, Steyn can only play a mistimed drive towards long-on
another good slower delivery, it misses Steyn's hoick and it misses the off stump by a whisker!! Vihari watches it all from the other end..
slower delivery, Steyn watches it carefully and punches it to wide long-off for a couple

caught at cover! Reddy gives it away, it was a high full toss, just below the waist, the batsman tries to give it everything, but gets a leading edge that only goes 10 meters high (roughly) and Kohli at cover takes an easy catch
fuller delivery outside off, he goes inside out over extra cover, but that was off the toe-end, long-off charges in to keep them to a single
another one fired on the middle stump, the batsman laps it to short fine leg for a single
quicker delivery on off stump, the batsman cuts it late and straight to Gayle at point, who fires it in, but had it hit, Vihari was gone..
bowls a fuller delivery wide outside off, the batsman was making room and he hits it inside out, hits it high and not long, the ball just drops short of long-off fielder
fuller delivery outside off, the batsman drives it in the air through cover for a single
he comes down the crease and slaps the length delivery down to long-off as Murali Kartik comes over the wicket
slower delivery on off stump, Vihari gets down on his knee as he spots it early and whacks it in the gap at cow corner, well picked there, in the gap..
he tries it again, but this time it is too quick for him, mistimes it to long on
he has found the range just in time, it was a length ball on stumps, the batsman arches back and gives it a mighty thwack over long-on, it just clears the boundary
back of length, it follows the batsman as he makes room, he can only hit it as far as Gayle at cover
slower delivery on off stump, the batsman drags it towards midwicket without any timing, they steal a single
length delivery aimed at the stumps, the batsman drives it to mid-off for a single
quicker delivery outside off, the batsman goes for a cut but is beaten
tossed up delivery, the batsman charges down and drives, but straight back to the bowler
he moves outside leg but pushes the length delivery to Kohli at cover
shorter, faster, wider outside off, the batsman punches it to deep point, goes off balance a bit as he hits that
tossed up delivery, it is driven down to long-off

this is a good hit, he makes room by moving outside leg and cuts it late to the vacant deep backward point where Vinay dives and keeps the ball in.. but hello, where is Mishra.. He is late in turning back for the third and he is miles out of the crease.. Absolutely unnecessary.. Mishra is a decent bat
slower length delivery angling across, the batsman guides it down the third man to keep the strike

slower delivery has dones the trick! Unadkat bowls an excellent back of the hand delivery, Thisara gets sucked into sending this out of the ground, he pulls, but gets no timing and he just ends up lobbing it towards deep midwicket where Moises accepts the catch...

length ball outside off, this is Perera for you, he hits it not with a bat but with a club, straight back past the bowler and the fielders in the deep had no chance, that went to the boundary in a matter of a second..
he moves outside the leg stump and swats the length delivery down to long-on for a single
bowls a sharp short delivery outside off, the batsman shapes to play a pull shot but sways away from the line
bowls short outside off, the batsman pulls it to deep midwicket, not much timing there for Vihari
tossed up outside off, slower as well, the batsman defends it to cover
this one is fired on the pads, the batsman doesn't get any bat on that but it flicks the pads on the way to the fine-leg boundary
he comes forward and punches the tossed up delivery to midwicket
tossed up delivery on off, the batsman drives it firmly down the ground, it hits the stumps and ricochets to long-on
flatter delivery wide outside off, the batsman cuts it hard to deep point
another quicker one on the stumps, the batsman works it to square leg off the back foot
he fires it down the leg side, wide called

another rising delivery outside off, the batsman dabs it to the left of point (Dilshan) and calls for a quick one, a throw comes to the non-striker's end and had it hit, it would have made life a bit more interesting for Sunrisers
back of length delivery, pushed back to the bowler

that's it! That is the big wicket! It was a pacy delivery and it took off from a length too, it was just outside off and Sanga tries to push it to the off side and edges it to the keeper, who dives to his left to gobble it up.. Big fish in the net..
oye! He tries to work the short of length delivery to the leg side but gets a leading edge over cover, lucky lucky

makes room by moving outside leg and slaps the length delivery straight to mid-on, they take on Chris Gayle, who fires in a flat throw that hits the stumps along the way... The batsman is short of the crease when the ball hits the stumps, but the bails come off later.. This is a big reprieve.. The ball had just kissed the stumps and that's why the bails took so long to come off..
length delivery wide outside off, the batsman crunches it straight to point and takes off for a single, but that went straight to point and just a little fumble allows a single
he comes down the pitch and chips a full delivery towards long on for an easy single
pushed through on the off stump, the batsman pushes it off the front foot to cover
tossed up on off stump, the batsman pushes it to midwicket
he sweeps this from outside off and it's in the air towards deep backward square leg, Moises runs from fine-leg and dives but the ball eludes him and runs to the boundary
pushed through on the pads, easily tucked to fine leg off the back foot
tossed up delivery on the stumps, the batsman dabs it to square leg for a quick single
this one is outside off, but the batsman drags it to long-on with a mow
flatter delivery outside off, Sanga waits in the crease and punches it to long-on
he comes down the pitch and punches the quicker delivery down to long-on
pushed through on the stumps, the batsman comes forward and drives it to long-off
another short ball wide outside off, this time he goes for a back foot punch to deep extra cover
short and wide outside off, Sanga pulls it over midwicket, well-placed in the gap there. He didn't hit it with power, just placed it in the gap
now he sweeps as he sees the line is on the stumps, hits it to short fine leg
oh that was the other one, tossed up wide outside off, the batsman plays a cut, but it beats the bat
bowls a quicker one as Sanga comes out of the crease, but the batsman flicks it on the leg side to fine leg
tossed up outside off, gets it to spin in from there, the batsman dabs it towards point for a single
gives it some more air, but this in on middle and leg line, Sanga punches it down the ground to long-on
full and flighted on the off stump, the batsman pushes it back to the bowler
length delivery outside off, slightly slower, the batsman cuts it in front of point and charges down for a couple
similar delivery, he hits it straight to backward point now
sees a bit of width and cuts it hard off the back foot, but is not able to beat the fielder at point
short delivery, but is comes with lack of pace, Sanga pulls it in front of square for an easy single
length ball just outside off stump, Sanga pushes it straight to cover off the front foot
bowls length delivery on off stump which the batsman chops down to third man off the back foot
pushed through on off stump, the batsman gets bit of inside edge as he defends that
he flicks it fine on the leg side, to fine leg for a single
full and flighted on the middle stumps, the batsman tucks it to square leg
bowls this one on the pads, the batsman gets some pad on it and it trickles fine towards the fine leg boundary. Gayle runs after it from first slip

this is classical Murali stuff! Tossed up outside off, the batsman makes the fatal mistake of going back to a delivery that is not short enough and is spinnings and dipping and turning in. His bat comes down to play it to off, but by that time, the off stump has been taken out...
tossed up delivery on off, goes straight on, the batsman dabs it to the leg side for a single
flicked in the air to midwicket, throw misses at the non-striker's end
cut down to third man
that was in the air for some time as he moved across to push a short of a length ball from close to the splice
bounce again from back of a length outside off, he runs it down to third man
sharp short ball, just outside off, he has a pull at it and misses
nips in from a length, around off, he turns it from the crease to square leg
lots of flight this time on a full delivery, driven to extra cover
good length and some bounce for Kartik, punched to long off once more
pushed to long off for one
punched to sweeper cover for a single
misses a sweep as Kartik sends this full and down leg
good length outside off, he goes back and slaps it down to long off
back of length delivery outside off, he stays on the back foot and chops it to deep backward point
length delivery on off, the batsman goes for an aerial shot on the leg side, but it hits the inside half of the bat and it goes to deep midwicket
another back of length delivery in the channel, the batsman goes back and runs it down to third man
length delivery, he pushes it towards mid-on and they take a quick single
length delivery wide outside off, he tries to punch it without moving his feet, chops it down to the keeper
back of length delivery on off stump, the batsman punches it to midwicket for a single
flighted delivery on the leg stump line, the batsman goes for a sweep but is hit on the pads, it rolls down to short fine leg
now he goes back to a flatter delivery and punches it down to long-off
he comes out of the crease and drives it through cover with just timing, didn't try to hit it hard at all, just placed it in the gap
he comes forward, dabs it to the off side and they call for a tight single
pushed up further and towards the leg stump, the batsman gets an inside edge to short fine leg
tossed up delivery on the stumps, the batsman comes forward and pushes it to midwicket
he too bowls a wide, this one is down the leg side
he stays in the crease and steers the length delivery straight to Gayle at gully...
length delivery in the channel outside off, the batsman goes back and across and defends it to point
gets a short of length delivery outside off which he defends solidly off the back foot

caught at mid-off! This one is the exact copy of how Agarwal got out to Steyn! He tries to loft the length ball over mid-off, but it bounces a touch extra and hits it high on the bat, it lobs towards the fielder at mid-off who completes an easy catch
back of length and on the stumps, a touch slower, the batsman defends it to the leg side
fuller length delivery outside off, the batsman pushes it to the off side without any timing, Gayle dives to his right but only makes a half-stop, concedes a single
and another one across the right-hander, this one was slower too and White is beaten again
back of length delivery, angled across the right-hander, goes away after pitching too and it beats the batsman's poke
he goes for a hoick at an angled delivery that is going across him, gets a thick outside edge that drops only a few meters short of the fielder at third man
better delivery this time, it's on a length on the middle stumps line, the batsman pushes it back to the bowler, who is unable to stop it cleanly, allows a single
and down the leg side again, they ask a question to the umpire in hope
fuller length on the pads, the batsman flicks it fine on the leg side, it beats the short fine leg fielder and off it goes to the boundary
length delivery, another one on a perfect line for a left-hander, but it's a wide for a right-hander
he pulls it over the midwicket fielder but doesn't time it well, it hits the top of the bat
back of length delivery on off stump, the batsman gets behind it solidly and defends it back to the bowler
short of length delivery down the leg side and the batsman helps it on its way off his hips to the fine leg boundary
another one straying on to the pads, the batsman tries to flick it but it hits the pads and rolls towards square leg, they take a quick one
gets this length delivery to straighten outside off, the batsman comes forward and defends it to point
bowls this one down the leg side, would have been a good ball to a left-hander

draws the outside edge off the first ball! This one was an innocuous length delivery going across the left hander, the batsman takes a short forward stride and tries to drive it on the up, ends up edging it to the keeper..
short of length outside off, the batsman defends it towards cover off the back foot
dropped by Gayle at gully! It wasn't an easy chance as it was flying towards the fielder, he jumped but wasn't able to hold on to the one that was slashed off the back foot
length ball outside off, Parthiv again doesn't move his feet, tries to punch it to off, straight to short point
back of length delivery on the stumps, the batsman pushes it towards mid-on with soft hands and they take a quick single
length delivery outside off, swinging away, Parthiv stays in the crease and guides it to third man
back of length delivery, cuts in to the batsman, who nudges it away to fine leg for a single
